title: Aqua Link
summary: A shared aquarium with one goldfish
description: A calm, volume-conserving aquarium spanning ESP-Mosaico and X1060. A small water surface and one animated goldfish respond to the mounted BMI270. Millimetre geometry, gentle waves, independent rendering and guarded ESP-NOW packet transactions support both displays.
changes: Calm 32-column water surface, 120-byte AQF3 snapshots, corrected camera-up mounting, independent direction controls and fast interpolated ARM rendering. XNOW dev.15 reduces repeated packet guard traffic.
